page.content:
Emperor who legalized Christianity and founded Constantinople.

How Constantine connects

  • Faction: Roman Empire — Constantine remade the late empire as a Christian monarchy.
  • Event: Edict of Milan — Constantine joined Licinius in legalizing Christianity in 313.

What is Constantine?

Constantine I won at the Milvian Bridge, issued the Edict of Milan, and moved the imperial center east. He is the hinge from pagan principate to Christian empire.

Key threads lead to Roman Empire and Edict of Milan.
